_about: Visitor-facing words for Ask the Tape. "offline" and "notices" are sent by the back end: the built-in rules' answer templates and the notice shown when built-in rules answered instead of the model. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by backend/app/agent/providers/offline_provider.py with numbers from LoanIQ's tools. Which question a rule answers is set in backend/app/config/llm.toml [[offline.rule]]; chip labels come from content/desk-questions.json. All data is synthetic; all numbers come from the tape. "screen" holds the Ask the Tape screen's own captions (frontend/src/screens/AskTheTapeScreen.tsx, Step 4b); the longer explanation is in screens/ask-the-tape.md.

agentMark.label: Agent
agentMark.openLabel: Agent: how the Ask the Tape agent works
agentMark.diagramAlt: The Ask the Tape agent loop. A question goes to Claude, which plans the next step and picks a tool. LoanIQ's orchestrator checks the call against its guardrails: one read-only query, known columns, row and time limits. The tool runs on DuckDB and the result goes back to Claude, which repeats until it can answer. The answer comes back with the SQL behind it. Who does what: Claude plans and explains; the orchestrator runs the loop and enforces the limits; the tools do every calculation; DuckDB is the single source of truth.
